title: Navy Blue Kota Doria Embroidered Kurta Pant Dupatta Set
description:
A graceful navy blue 3-piece suit set in airy Kota Doria from Rajasthan, finished with fine white thread embroidery – made in Jaipur by Bahe Kurtiz.

The kurta has a rich embroidered yoke with paisley and floral vine motifs, matching embroidered sleeve borders and soft cotton lining, so it is light, breathable and not see-through. It comes with comfortable cotton pants (elastic back waist and side pocket) and a sheer Kota Doria dupatta with embroidered border and scattered buti all over.

• Kurta: Kota Doria with cotton lining, round neck, 3/4 sheer sleeves, side slits, straight fit
• Pant: pure cotton, straight ankle length, elastic waist, pocket
• Dupatta: Kota Doria with white embroidered border and buti
• Kota Doria's signature checked weave (khat) keeps you cool in summer and festive at the same time
• Perfect for Diwali, Eid, haldi and mehendi, office festive days and wedding guest looks

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash. After that gentle hand wash in cold water, dry in shade, iron on low heat on the reverse side.
